description: The Hummingbird Cryptographic Module is a library which provides encryption and decryption services to Hummingbird Connectivity software during SSL or SSH connections. The Hummingbird Cryptographic Module is used in Exceed, a windows-based X11 server, NFS Maestro, a suite of NFS clients and servers, HostExplorer, a desktop and web-based terminal emulation suite and Connectivity Secure Shell, an implementation of the Secure Shell 2 protocol. The Hummingbird Cryptographic Module is available from Hummingbird Connectivity, a division of Open Text Corporation.
